vision: Implement a scalable, proactive data quality framework for the enterprise analytics platform to detect, alert, and remediate data issues across completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness dimensions, improving trust and reducing costs from data errors.
scope: The epic covers design and implementation of a data quality framework leveraging Great Expectations and Airflow, integrated with Databricks and Snowflake, and connected to alerting tools (Slack, PagerDuty) and data catalogs (Atlan/DataHub). It includes automated profiling, configurable rule management, dashboards, alerting, and runbooks for resolution. Out of scope are non-critical datasets and non-SQL data sources.
success_criteria: 90% reduction in downstream data defects within 3 months after deployment to critical tables
Quality checks add ≤10% to pipeline runtime and maintain SLA compliance

user_stories.title: Enable automated data profiling for new data sources upon registration
user_stories.i_want: to trigger automated profiling jobs when new sources are added to the pipeline
user_stories.so_that: data quality baselines are established immediately and rules can be configured proactively

acceptance_criteria.given: a new data source is registered in Databricks/Snowflake
acceptance_criteria.then: the system generates completeness and uniqueness metrics automatically

user_stories.title: Provide configurable YAML-based data quality rules for each dataset
user_stories.i_want: to define and manage data quality rules via YAML files
user_stories.so_that: validation logic can be easily maintained across datasets without code changes

acceptance_criteria.given: a dataset has an associated YAML rule file
acceptance_criteria.when: Airflow runs a Great Expectations validation
acceptance_criteria.then: the checks execute according to rules defined in the YAML

user_stories.title: Implement real-time data quality alerting via Slack and PagerDuty
user_stories.i_want: to receive alerts when data quality thresholds are breached
user_stories.so_that: critical data issues can be resolved immediately and alert fatigue minimized

acceptance_criteria.given: a quality check fails with severity above defined threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: alerts appear in Slack and PagerDuty grouped by severity and domain

user_stories.title: Provide a dashboard showing data quality scores per business domain
user_stories.i_want: to view aggregated quality metrics for tables relevant to my domain
user_stories.so_that: I can assess trustworthiness of the data before using it in analysis or reporting

acceptance_criteria.given: quality scores are calculated for completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays domain-level scores and trends for all monitored tables

user_stories.title: Implement self-healing workflows for common data issues detected
user_stories.i_want: to automatically trigger remediation scripts for known error patterns such as missing partitions or NULL replacements
user_stories.so_that: data pipelines can recover without manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: a detected data issue matches a known remediation pattern
acceptance_criteria.then: the framework executes an automated correction job and logs the action

user_stories.title: Expose key data quality metrics in Atlan/DataHub catalogs
user_stories.i_want: to view data quality indicators directly in the catalog alongside metadata
user_stories.so_that: I can make informed decisions on data reliability before consumption

acceptance_criteria.given: a table has computed data quality scores
acceptance_criteria.when: a user accesses the catalog entry
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays latest quality metrics for that table
